name: PhotoCraft v0.10.0
body:
## Scorecard since v0.9.0

From [`docs/scorecard.md`](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/blob/v0.10.0/docs/scorecard.md) (done / partial / missing):

- **Tools:** 29 / 13 / 1 → **33 / 11 / 0**. Done: per-control pressure curves, image files as brush tips, Pen Shift 45° constraints, arrow-key nudges bundled into one History state.
- **File compatibility:** 7 / 13 / 7 → **7 / 14 / 6**; PDF save went from missing to partial (one flattened page with ICC).
- **Corpus floors raised:** Photoshop oracles 145 → **188** / 256, psd-tools 236 → **249** / 309, io corpus 146 → **148** / 170 (round-trip floors unchanged).
- **Reliability:** never-crash lints on 30 of 30 crates (was 28 of 28).
- **Workspace and UI:** unchanged at 13 / 6 / 4; settings that do nothing 26 of 168 (157 before, after new settings landed).
- **Performance:** two new scenarios tracked (P60/P61, layer opacity and visibility among 150 layers), not run yet; budgets met unchanged at 3 (baseline 2026-10-05).

## What's Changed
* Keep channel pastes transactional when memory allocation fails by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4588
* Bound selection sampling and report layer-buffer allocation failures by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4594
